answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the whisper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, converted to a slow vesting stream, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The grove is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the canyon.
